digest.component_or_area: external LLM live integration matrix gate
propositions: The live external matrix guard at test_provider_matrix_live.py:88 rejects openai model specs because it compares literal provider qualifier 'openai-chat' against declared arm provider family 'openai' and fails equality.

The live LLM credential map _PROVIDER_KEY_ENV lacks 'openai-chat' entry, so configured_provider() returns 'openai-chat' but credential_present() looks for 'openai', causing live_llm_ready() to return False and all openai-arm live tests to skip.

Commit 8f4c5fdb0d3 renamed the openai qualifier to 'openai-chat' and updated the unit-tier matrix gate with a family->qualifier mapping but did not update live external tier consumers of the provider name.

The guard's intent — validating the arm runs its declared provider family — is satisfied by openai-chat specs (both name the same family), so the failure is a false positive and a regression from pre-8f4c5fdb runs.

The fix adds a qualifier->family map to _live_llm.py and a provider_family() helper so configured_provider() returns the family name, making credential lookup and guard comparisons agree with REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER.
